title: voice_model_selection.md
content:
# One Selected Voice-Model Per NPC

Each NPC is locked to exactly one fantasy voice-model based on their biome assignment. Race, class/personality, gender identity, emotion, and sliders modify that one selected model rather than swapping it out.

| NPC | Biome | Accent inspiration | Selected single voice-model |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Joeari Ravenwood | Deep cavern | Welsh | Stonehollow Echo |
| Ghearir’iel Luneglen | Treetops / treehouses | French | Highbranch Lilt |
| Thalenael Silverthorn | Deep forest | German | Rootmere Cant |
| Nimu’dri Ironvault | Deep cavern | Welsh | Stonehollow Echo |
| Ro’sabin Merryroot | Hybrid tree and forest floor | English West Country | Bramblewood Burr |
| Urg-U’rgugar Mudgrip | Prairie | Russian | Ironstep Cant |
| Valk-Minoorvar Thunderheft | Mountain range | Scottish | Cragthane Burr |
| Kethazzun Clawcoil | Beach and reefs with water | Hawaiian-influenced English | Wavebloom Welcome |
| Veyielven Asharchf | Treetops / treehouses | French | Highbranch Lilt |
| Nefumlith Duskendirge | Marshes and swamps | Louisiana Cajun / Creole-influenced English | Mirecurl Drawl |
| Tyrylina Mirthwink | Valley | Italian | Vinesong Flow |
| Sto’neudor Stormbreath | Ocean surface floating settlement | Portuguese | Tidecrest Cant |
| Arcorven Brasslock | Deep cavern | Welsh | Stonehollow Echo |
| Canielina Dennose | Deep forest | German | Rootmere Cant |

## Model behavior summary

- **Stonehollow Echo**: deeper resonance, throat depth, slower timing, spacious pauses, carved-stone clarity.
- **Highbranch Lilt**: airy pitch, flowing vowels, refined formality, polished phrase shape.
- **Rootmere Cant**: stronger consonants, structured cadence, forest authority, precise articulation.
- **Bramblewood Burr**: warmer rustic woodland rhythm, grounded body, relaxed formality.
- **Ironstep Cant**: grounded resonance, clipped bite, martial projection, hardy timing.
- **Cragthane Burr**: rugged projection, rough mountain edge, strong chest/body feel.
- **Wavebloom Welcome**: warm flow, gentle rhythm, soft consonants, welcoming wave cadence.
- **Mirecurl Drawl**: slower swamp rhythm, wet-earth pauses, warmth, breath, and lived-in flow.
- **Vinesong Flow**: musical vowel motion, emotional rhythm, expressive warmth.
- **Tidecrest Cant**: rolling maritime rhythm, warm open vowels, lively projection.


## Repository voice folder layer

See `REPOSITORY_VOICE_ASSIGNMENTS.md` for the new one-folder-per-NPC assignments from the attached voice pack. The biome model remains the accent/behavior model; the repository folder is the selected voice identity/reference sent to the backend and embedded as a voice stamp.
